edits.before: Mashujaa hutumia uwanja wa mbio na bwawa la kuogelea pia. Wanaweza pia kufunza ujuzi wa kushambulia katika kambi za jeshi.
edits.after: Mashujaa hutumia uwanja wa mbio na bwawa la kuogelea pia. Wanaweza pia kupata mafunzo ya kushambulia katika kambi za jeshi.
edits.rationale: Warriors receive training to improve their own attack skills; kufunza incorrectly makes them teach.

edits.before: Kambi ya jeshi iko tayari. Mashujaa sasa wanaweza kufunza ujuzi wao wa kushambulia humo.
edits.after: Kambi ya jeshi iko tayari. Mashujaa sasa wanaweza kupata mafunzo ya kushambulia humo.
edits.rationale: Warriors receive training to improve their own attack skills; kufunza incorrectly makes them teach.

edits.before: Wafanyakazi waliofunzwa shuleni wanaweza kujenga maboresho. Chagua jengo linalostahiki na utafute Boresha katika vidhibiti vyake. Majengo yaliyoharibika yanaweza kuhitaji Ukarabati kwanza.
edits.after: Wafanyakazi waliofunzwa shuleni wanaweza kujenga maboresho. Chagua jengo linalostahiki na utafute Boresha katika vidhibiti vyake. Majengo yaliyoharibika yanaweza kuhitaji uchague Rekebisha kwanza.
edits.rationale: Refer to actual Repair button Rekebisha with choose verb, not a mismatched Ukarabati noun label.

edits.before: Subiri minara yote miwili na vipande kadhaa vya ukuta vikamilike. Minara pia inahitaji mawe ya risasi; machimbo ya mbali hufanya usafirishaji uwe wa polepole. Ongeza malengo yake ya wafanyakazi ukiwa na walio huru.
edits.after: Subiri ujenzi wa minara yote miwili na vipande kadhaa vya ukuta ukamilike. Minara pia inahitaji mawe ya risasi; machimbo ya mbali hufanya usafirishaji uwe wa polepole. Ongeza malengo yake ya wafanyakazi ukiwa na walio huru.
edits.rationale: Use singular construction as subject to avoid incorrect agreement across minara and vipande; preserve tower/wall timing.

edits.before: Weka lengo la wafanyakazi wa eneo la ujenzi wa uwanja wa mbio kati ya 5 na 7. Unahitaji jumla ya vifaa 7 vya ujenzi.
edits.after: Weka lengo la wafanyakazi wa eneo la ujenzi wa uwanja wa mbio kati ya 5 na 7. Unahitaji jumla ya vipimo 7 vya malighafi za ujenzi.
edits.rationale: Align harvested, stored and delivered material inventory with Malighafi; update noun-class concord, distinguish quantities from creatures and genuine equipment/vifaa.

edits.before: Uwanja wa mbio ukikamilika, huwafunza viumbe wanaofika bila kuhitaji usambazaji wa kudumu wa vifaa au ngano.
edits.after: Uwanja wa mbio ukikamilika, huwafunza viumbe wanaofika bila kuhitaji usambazaji wa kudumu wa malighafi za ujenzi au ngano.
edits.rationale: Align harvested, stored and delivered material inventory with Malighafi; update noun-class concord, distinguish quantities from creatures and genuine equipment/vifaa.

editor_notes: Read every one of126 tutorial entries against frozen source, in contiguous 0–64 and65–125 views; no omitted/truncated segment. Warriors receive attack training rather than teach it. Repair reference uses actual Rekebisha action, with choose verb. Mixed-class subjects avoided in towers/wall-sections completion sentence. Space, OK/Sawa, Working, Build/Jenga, Upgrade/Boresha, Guard/Ulinzi, Paint/Chora, Erase/Futa, Pan/Sogeza references crosschecked; exact technical keys and scenario conditions untouched. Source material terminology normalized in separate source-checked sweep.

Source-checked material inventory terminology sweep: Malighafi for harvested/stocked/delivered material, distinct from genuine equipment/vifaa; noun-class concord corrected with each change. No target-only blanket replacement.
certification: Agent edited; not native-human-certified; rendering/platform gates separate
